en: Black‑and‑white view of a cobbled town square with late‑19th‑century buildings. In the center stands a large statue of a man in a long coat on a high pedestal inscribed "ALBERT." Around the monument are short stone posts connected by chains. The surrounding façades carry German‑language shop signs, including a shoe store and other merchants, with decorative gabled roofs and dormer windows.
